bacaan.teks:
Compare the two short messages below for questions number 16 to 20!

Message 1: "Dear Fajar, congratulations on winning the Gold Medal in the Provincial Swimming Championship! Your hard work every morning finally paid off. I hope you succeed in the national round next month! — Coach Bima"

Message 2: "Hi Nadia, I am really sorry for not attending your study group yesterday afternoon. My little brother had a high fever, so I had to take care of him at home. I hope we can study together tomorrow at the library. — Rani"

teks_soal: [Tabel Benar / Salah (True or False)] Read the statements based on Message 1 and Message 2, then give a tick in the True or False column!
soal: [Tabel Benar / Salah (True or False)] Read the statements based on Message 1 and Message 2, then give a tick in the True or False column!

pernyataan.teks: In Message 1, "congratulations on winning..." is followed by a gerund (Verb-ing).
In Message 2, "I am really sorry for not attending..." expresses gratitude (terima kasih).
Both Coach Bima and Rani use the word "hope" to express a future wish that is possible to happen.

pembahasan: (a) True: preposisi "on" diikuti gerund (winning). (b) False: ungkapan tersebut menyatakan permintaan maaf (apology), bukan terima kasih. (c) True: kedua pesan menggunakan kata "hope" untuk harapan yang mungkin terjadi.
capaian_pembelajaran: Menggunakan ungkapan terima kasih, permohonan maaf, serta harapan/doa (wish & hope) dalam interaksi interpersonal sesuai konteks budaya kesantunan berbahasa.
